title: Hospital for Sale in Kumbla (Kumble), India
tagline: Located in Kumbla, Kasaragod district, our maternity and general hospital is currently operating as a small-scale nursing home. - We specialize in obstetrics and gynecology (OB-GYN), providing outpatient care to women and mothers in the local community. - We currently operate exclusively on an outpatient (OP) basis and generate monthly revenue of approximately INR 2–2.5 lakh from these services. - Approximately three years ago, the facility also provided inpatient services, pharmacy services, and laboratory facilities, generating monthly revenue of around INR 4–5 lakh. - The hospital has a capacity of 25 beds, which are currently not operational. - The business holds an FTE and OS licence issued by Kumbla Gram Panchayat, a registration certificate from the Labour Department, Government of Kerala, under the Kerala Shops and Commercial Establishments Act, and a Certificate of Registration for Private Hospitals and Private Paramedical Institutions under Rule 5 of the Kerala Panchayat Raj Rules, 1997. - The business also has MTP and PCPNDT ACT Licenses. - The hospital is not currently accredited by the National Accreditation Board for Hospitals and Healthcare Providers (NABH).
